top_signals.title: Why Nvidia's 'defensive move' to acquire Hugging Face is about much more than chips
top_signals.summary: Nvidia’s $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal could protect its open AI ecosystem, deepen ties with developers and keep the platform from rivals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
